environment: Playwright 1.64.1 / Chromium 156.0.8078.4 headless, macOS arm64 with SwiftShader; phone is the 390 x 844 touch-emulated project at device scale 2
fixture: Disposable in-memory family-mode household. Rowan (owner, adult), Ash (adult) and Wren (child) each sign in with their own virtual passkey. The real Channel3 merchant code runs over a fake transport returning three invented tents ($120.00, $150.00, $180.00). The server day starts at Nov 8, 2026; the goal starts at $300.00 with $60.00 reported, $30.00 a week and a Dec 20 date. Offers: Rowan $20.00, Ash $10.00.
spec: test/e2e/family-schedule.spec.mjs — a family carries a reviewed one-off $90 into a proposed, then accepted, weekly schedule with each adult’s share
steps: The owner shortlists three Market Town results (one explicit search); Rowan and Ash save their own weekly offers
The owner types a one-off $90.00 (no request) and chooses "Review this choice" for the $150.00 tent: capture the unsaved preview
The owner chooses "Save goal and propose this schedule", then "Use this plan": capture the accepted schedule
The test moves the server day to Nov 15 and Ash signs in again: capture the Treasury week

images.story: Preview: "Review this choice" with a one-off $90.00 tried. The unsaved goal draft lists weeks 1–3 (Nov 15–Nov 29) as $0.00 to the goal, each week’s $30.00 going to the expense, then weeks 4–6 (Dec 6–Dec 20) at $30.00 a week, Rowan $20.00 · Ash $10.00. Two explicit actions: "Save goal and propose this schedule" or "Save as our goal".
